text:
ITEM 1 | Broccoli florets in a loose cluster, bright green with darker green tips, dry-looking surface with a slightly bumpy texture, firm and holding shape, about 7 x 5 cm footprint and about 3 cm tall, sitting on the upper-left of the plate near the pear | 25 g
ITEM 2 | Fresh strawberry pieces, red with lighter pale-cream interior and small seed dots, glossy and moist-looking, firm, cut into halves and slices about 2 to 4 cm each, spread along the upper-right edge of the plate | 80 g
ITEM 3 | Whole green pear, smooth yellow-green skin with darker mottled patches and a small brown stem end, firm and intact, round about 9 to 10 cm across and about 8 cm tall, sitting in the center of the plate | 170 g
ITEM 4 | Cubed roasted potato pieces, golden-tan with browned edges and slightly crisp-looking exterior, cut into irregular cubes about 2 to 2.5 cm each, clustered at the lower-right of the pear, dry and firm | 40 g
